name: 88-port-parse-error-not-named
old:
try:
        host = unquote(parts.hostname) if parts.hostname else None
        port = parts.port
    except ValueError as exc:  # 端口非整数 / 端口越界
        raise RedisUrlError(
            f"Redis URL 非法（{_safe_reason(exc, text)}）: {shown!r}"
        ) from exc
new:
host = unquote(parts.hostname) if parts.hostname else None
    port = parts.port
rationale: 非法端口抛裸 ValueError（非具名 RedisUrlError），调用方分不清是配置错还是别处错
